newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 364-day t-bill average yield 6.41 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 364-day t-bill average yield 6.41 pct.

text.p: Bank Negara Malaysia said it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.41 percent at its auction of 364-day treasury bills for 100 million ringgit.
At its previous auction of 364-day treasury bills on April 10 for a similar amount, the average yield was 6.275 percent.
The bids accepted were in a high/low range of 6.429/375 percent against 6.298/239 previously.
Payment for the issue is on Friday.
Bank Negara said it will hold the next auction of 92-day treasury bills for 80 million ringgit and 183-day bills for 100 million ringgit on May 2.
